## Loading In Data

```{r}

  mutate(Humpback = as.factor(Humpback))


data_test = read.csv(here::here("EvaluationSet", "annotatedMELAWFull2000-Testing.csv")) %>%
  mutate(Humpback = as.factor(Humpback))
```

## Creating Training Data

```{r}

trainingdata = add_observations_linear(whaledf = data_train,
                                start_time = 3600,
                                end_time =  4000,
                                num_time_steps = 20, 
                                numcep = 12,
                                step_size = 0.1,
                                jump_size = 0.05)



table(trainingdata$Humpback)

trainingdata %>% select(Time_Start, Time_End, Humpback)

```

## Creating Testing Data


```{r}
testingdata = add_observations_linear(whaledf = data_test,

                                end_time =  7800,
                                num_time_steps = 20,

testingdata %>% select(Time_Start, Time_End, Humpback)
```

## Loading in Annotations

```{r}
manual_annotations_evaluation = 
  read_excel(here::here("OrigData", "AW", "AWhb.xlsx")) %>% 
    rename(Begin_Time = 'Begin Time (s)', End_Time = 'End Time (s)') %>%
  filter(Begin_Time >= min(testingdata$Time_Start) & End_Time <= max(testingdata$Time_End))

nrow(manual_annotations_evaluation)
```





## Creating Final Model

```{r}
# TEMP NEIGHBORS VALUE
neighbors_param = 10

# creating model
knnmod_1 <- nearest_neighbor(
  neighbors = neighbors_param,
  weight_func = "rectangular",
  dist_power = 2
) %>%
  set_engine("kknn") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

# creating recipe
knnrecipe_1 <- recipe(Humpback ~ ., data = trainingdata) %>%
  step_rm(Time_Start, Time_End) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_dummy(all_factor_predictors())

# creating workflow
knnworkflow_1 <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(knnmod_1) %>%
  add_recipe(knnrecipe_1)

# fitting model
knnfit_1 = knnworkflow_1 %>%
  fit(trainingdata)
```



## Predicting on Testing Data


```{r}
predictionsdf = testingdata %>% mutate(preds = predict(knnfit_1, testingdata)$.pred_class)

table(predictionsdf$preds)
predictionsdf %>% select("Time_Start", "Time_End",   "Humpback",   "preds")
```

## Metrics Type 1

```{r}
whale_call_metrics_type1 <- function(row, predictionsdf) {
  agg_window_length <- as.numeric(row[1])
  agg_window_threshold <- as.numeric(row[2])

  rolling_average <- rolling_avg_df(
    predictionsdf,
    agg_window_length,
    agg_window_threshold
  )
  
  print(rolling_average)
    
  if (nrow(rolling_average %>% filter(rolling_avg_prediction == 1)) == 0) {
    knneval_recall <- 0
    knneval_precision <- NA
    
  } else if (nrow(rolling_average %>% filter(rolling_avg_prediction == 0)) == 0) {
    knneval_recall <- 1
    knneval_precision <- nrow(rolling_average %>% filter(Humpback == 1)) /
      nrow(rolling_average %>% filter(rolling_avg_prediction == 1))
    
  } else if (nrow(rolling_average %>% filter(Humpback == 1)) == 0) {
    knneval_recall <- NA
    knneval_precision <- 0
    
  } else {
    knneval_recall <- rolling_average %>%
      recall(truth = Humpback, estimate = rolling_avg_prediction, event_level = "second") %>%
      pull(.estimate)
    
    knneval_precision <- rolling_average %>%
      precision(truth = Humpback, estimate = rolling_avg_prediction, event_level = "second") %>%
      pull(.estimate)
  }
  
  knneval_f1 <- (2 * knneval_recall * knneval_precision) / (knneval_recall + knneval_precision)
  knneval_f2 <- (5 * knneval_recall * knneval_precision) / (knneval_recall + 4 * knneval_precision)
  
  data.frame(
    agg_window_length = agg_window_length,
    agg_window_threshold = agg_window_threshold,
    Recall = knneval_recall,
    Precision = knneval_precision,
    F1 = knneval_f1,
    F2 = knneval_f2
  )
}


final_df <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    whale_call_metrics_type1(grid[i, ], predictionsdf)
  })
)
```



## Metrics Type 2


```{r}
whale_call_metrics_type2 <- function(row, predictionsdf) {
  agg_window_length <- as.numeric(row[1])
  agg_window_threshold <- as.numeric(row[2])

  rolling_average <- rolling_avg_df(
    predictionsdf,
    agg_window_length,
    agg_window_threshold
  )

  prediction_windows <- creating_prediction_windows(
    rolling_average,
    time_start = Time_Start,
    time_end = Time_End,
    value_col = rolling_avg_prediction
  )

  conf_matrix_table <- confusion_from_intervals(
    data_true = manual_annotations_evaluation,
    data_pred = prediction_windows,
    true_interval_start = Begin_Time,
    true_interval_end = End_Time,
    pred_interval_start = start_time,
    pred_interval_end = end_time
  )

  TP <- conf_matrix_table %>% dplyr::pull(TP)
  FN <- conf_matrix_table %>% dplyr::pull(FN)
  FP <- conf_matrix_table %>% dplyr::pull(FP)

  num_pred_windows <- nrow(prediction_windows)

  if (TP + FN == 0) {
    recall <- NA_real_
  } else {
    recall <- TP / (TP + FN)
  }

  if (TP + FP == 0) {
    precision <- NA_real_
  } else {
    precision <- TP / (TP + FP)
  }

  if (is.na(recall) || is.na(precision) || (recall + precision == 0)) {
    F1 <- NA_real_
  } else {
    F1 <- 2 * recall * precision / (recall + precision)
  }

  if (is.na(recall) || is.na(precision) || (4 * precision + recall == 0)) {
    F2 <- NA_real_
  } else {
    F2 <- 5 * precision * recall / (4 * precision + recall)
  }

  data.frame(
    agg_window_length = agg_window_length,
    agg_window_threshold = agg_window_threshold,
    num_pred_windows = num_pred_windows,
    recall = recall,
    precision = precision,
    F1 = F1,
    F2 = F2
  )
}

final_df <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    whale_call_metrics_type2(grid[i, ], predictionsdf)
  })
)


sorted_df = final_df %>% data.frame() %>% arrange(desc(F2))

sorted_df

manual_annotations_evaluation
```

## PR Curve


```{r}



sorted_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = recall, y = precision, color = as.factor(agg_window_length), group = as.factor(agg_window_length))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "blue", "green", "yellow", "orange", "purple")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Precision-Recall Curve of Different Number of Neighbors",
    x = "Recall",
    y = "Precision",
    color = "Window Length"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
